description: The Hyperliquid cohort vocabulary and its latest-snapshot positioning, by `view`. `cohorts`: the label sets per ladder, the exact spellings every `cohort` parameter accepts. `segments`: the catalogue with bounds, ranks and what each ladder measures (`size` is account value in USD; `pnl` is a percentile rank of cumulative realized PnL, not dollars; `pnl_abs` is dollars). `summary`: everything ONE cohort holds right now across all symbols: long/short notional in USD, `bias` a fraction from -1 to +1, `pct_wallets_in_profit` a FRACTION from 0 to 1 despite its name, `exposure_ratio` = notional / margin used, `perp_bias` = (long - short) / equity and `equity_exposure` = (long + short) / equity, native perp account only: positions on the main dex over the native perp account value (each wallet once, the whole account even under `opened_within`); builder-DEX positions are not included; wallets without a known positive native equity are left out of perp_bias, equity_exposure and this share's numerator, see `equity_covered_share` (main-dex notional of the counted wallets / of the whole cohort). Unbounded ratios (above 1 = over 1x; null when equity <= 0); that equity is not `total_equity`, so perp_bias x total_equity != total_long_usd - total_short_usd. `heatmap`: the whole symbol x cohort board (large: every symbol with open interest; empty cells are omitted). Positions are the latest 5-minute snapshot. `history`: ONE cohort (`cohort` + `axis`, both required; `axis` is `size` or `pnl` only) hour by hour, summed over all symbols, newest first, from 2026-04-07: `long_usd` and `short_usd` in USD, `bias` = (long - short) / (long + short), a RATIO from -1 to +1 (null when both are 0), `position_count` = open positions, NOT wallets. Each hour carries the cohort label it had then (`label_basis` is `point_in_time`; `pnl` labels are daily before 2026-08-06, see `label_computed`). `hours` sizes the window, `limit` caps the rows, `has_more` says older rows exist. With `include=leverage` each hour also carries `perp_bias`, `equity_exposure` and `equity_covered_share`, the three `summary` ratios of that hour (null before 2026-08-11 and for a missing hour; `perp_bias` and `equity_exposure` are also null where no wallet has a known positive equity, and `equity_covered_share` is 0 when none is counted). An unknown cohort for the axis is an error. Same data as GET /v1/hl-cohorts/{cohorts, segments, segments/{cohort}/summary, heatmap, segments/{cohort}/history}.

axis.description: Cohort ladder: `size` = account-value tiers in USD, `pnl` = percentile rank of cumulative realized PnL (NOT dollars), `pnl_abs` = dollar bands of that same PnL. Per-position `trade_size` / `tier` is refused here. `history` serves history for `size` and `pnl` only, and requires `axis`. Default by view: summary size, heatmap size. Used by view: summary, heatmap, history. Required by view: history.

cohort.description: One label on `axis`, spelled exactly as `hl_segments` view=cohorts lists it, e.g. `whale` (size) or `3x smart` (pnl). Used by view: summary, history. Required by view: summary, history.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. `history` only: with no `start`, the window is the `hours` newest hours at or before it. Used by view: history.

hours.description: `history` only: window length in hours when `start` is omitted, ending at `end` or now. Max 8760. Used by view: history.

include.description: `history` only: comma list, only `leverage`; default none (nothing extra is read). Adds to every hourly row `perp_bias` = (long - short) / equity, `equity_exposure` = (long + short) / equity and `equity_covered_share` = main-dex notional of the counted wallets / main-dex notional of the whole cohort: unbounded ratios (above 1 = more than 1x of equity), native perp account only (main-dex positions of wallets with a known positive native equity, each wallet once; builder-DEX positions are not included). An hour with no stored row, and any hour before `leverage.data_from` (2026-08-11), is null on all three (never 0). `perp_bias` and `equity_exposure` are also null when no counted wallet has a positive equity; `equity_covered_share` is null when the cohort holds no main-dex notional and a real 0 when it holds some but no wallet is counted. Hours rebuilt from fills rather than read from snapshots are null. An unknown token is refused. Used by view: history.

limit.description: `history` only: max hourly rows, newest first; `has_more` says older ones exist, page back with `end` = the oldest `ts` minus 1 second. Max 5000. Used by view: history.

opened_within.description: Only positions opened within this window: `24h`, `7d`, `30d` or `all`; positions with no known open time are left out of every bounded window. Used by view: summary, heatmap.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. `history` only; hours before 2026-04-07 are never returned. Used by view: history.

view.description: What to read. `segments`: the catalogue of every cohort bucket with its bounds and what the ladder measures. `cohorts`: the flat label sets, i.e. the exact spellings every `cohort` parameter accepts. `summary`: what ONE cohort holds right now across all symbols. `heatmap`: the whole symbol x cohort board at the latest snapshot. `history`: ONE cohort's hourly long, short and bias summed over all symbols, newest first (axis size or pnl only). Default `segments`.
